_source: OSRIC 3.0 Player Guide, Chapter Three: Character Classes. Verified against PDF (Fighter 1.3.4, Cleric 1.3.2, Magic-User 1.3.6, Thief 1.3.10; Assassin 1.3.1, Druid 1.3.3, Illusionist 1.3.5, Monk 1.3.7, Paladin 1.3.8, Ranger 1.3.9).
_thac0_note: thac0 = number needed (d20) to hit descending Armour Class 0. Needed roll vs a target = thac0 - target_ac_descending. Natural 20 always hits; natural 1 always misses.
_hd_note: hd_count d(hit_die) are rolled; hp_bonus is fixed hp added on top (used past the hit-die cap). Constitution hp_mod applies per die rolled, not to the fixed bonus.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.weapons_allowed: blunt (club, flail, hammer, mace, staff, torch)

thief.name: Thief
thief.armour_allowed: leather, padded, or studded leather only
thief.weapons_allowed: club, dagger, dart, oil, sling, most swords (not bastard or two-handed), torch

thief_skills._backstab: damage multiplier by level tier (in addition to +4 to-hit)
damage multiplier by level tier (in addition to +4 to-hit); may instead roll extra damage dice (+1 die per tier above x2)

druid.name: Druid
druid.weapons_allowed: club, dagger, dart, hammer, scimitar, sling, spear, staff, torch

monk.name: Monk
monk.weapons_allowed: club, crossbow, dagger, hand axe, javelin, pole arm, spear, staff (no oil or poison)

thief_skills._note: Monks have no backstab, pick-pockets or read-languages skills; these thief-style skills may be modified by Dexterity (Table 1.3.10.4c).

spellcaster._note: Cleric spells from 9th level (casting level = paladin level - 8, capped at cleric level 8); no high-Wisdom bonus slots. Type deliberately kept out of 'divine' so the engine does not add cleric bonus slots.

Druidic spells from 8th level (in spell_slots) and arcane/magic-user spells from 9th level (in spell_slots_arcane); no high-Wisdom bonus slots. Type deliberately kept out of 'divine' so the engine does not add cleric bonus slots. The engine's spell_slots() surfaces only the druidic list.
